# TrackLab AI datasets
#
# Large videos stay outside git. This directory only stores:
#   - manifest.json  (paths, sha256, split, task metadata)
#
# Synthetic CI clips live in tests/ai/fixtures/ and are generated by:
#   python -m tests.ai.generate_fixtures
#
# Split rules:
#   ci      — tiny frozen set, runs on every commit (<2 min)
#   dev     — full training/selection set
#   holdout — 20% hidden; do not tune models against this split
#
# When replacing a synthetic slot with real footage:
#   1. put the file under an external data root
#   2. update relative_path + sha256 in manifest.json
#   3. write a matching annotation JSON under tests/ai/fixtures/annotations/
#   4. re-run: python -m tests.ai.evaluate --split ci --model oracle
#      (SAM 2.1 Tiny is opt-in: python -m tests.ai.evaluate --split ci --model sam2)
